key_insight: Non-Variational QWOA amplifies high-quality solutions to the Closest String problem using a gate-level workflow without instance-specific parameter optimization.
engineering_relevance: The automated circuit construction and analytical resource estimates support hardware planning for quantum combinatorial optimization.
method: Encode candidate strings and evaluate their maximum Hamming distance to the reference strings.
Apply NV-QWOA iterations using a problem-size-dependent phase parameter to mitigate excessive phase wrapping.
Compile into one- and two-qubit gates, with O(nm log k) qubits and O(pm log² n + pn log n) circuit depth.
evidence_signal: Across all simulated problem sizes, the algorithm consistently amplified optimal and near-optimal candidates.
watch_item: Simulation-based amplification does not establish practical quantum advantage; hardware validation and classical benchmarking remain necessary.
paper_title: Designing Quantum Solutions to the Closest String Problem with the Non-Variational QWOA
